column1: # branicki1757: the alphabet of key.tsv and the number code of numbers.md in one table, so that the readings of
# 446, 1398, 1399 and 1400 can be regenerated from a key file. Added 16 Nov 2026 (decrypt audit). Nothing here is new:
# every row is copied from the file named in its source column. The letter rows are key.tsv unchanged.
# A plain value "-" means the group gives no letter (punctuation or null). Only the punctuation and null numbers that
# occur in the four transcriptions are listed; the rule is 830 to 850 punctuation, 851 and up nulls.
# In the transcriptions of 446, 1399 and 1400 a number is followed by a dot (845.); the dot is not part of the group.
# Number words: 824 is printed "mil" in the date of 1400 and 805 "premier" in "au premier d'août" (1399).
# Not in this table, because numbers.md does not fix them:
#   guesses, printed [?word] in the readings: 245 Courlande, 345 la Famille, 495 Livonie, 550 occasion, 596 Pologne,
